codesFaq.question: Does No Man’s Sky have redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: No. Hello Games has never added a redeem-code system to No Man’s Sky. Free items arrive through Twitch Drops campaigns, expedition rewards, Nexus community missions, and weekend events — any site listing “active NMS codes” is outdated or clickbait.

codesFaq.question: How do I claim Twitch Drops in No Man’s Sky?
codesFaq.answer: Link your Twitch and platform accounts on Hello Games’ official drops page, watch drops-enabled No Man’s Sky streams during a campaign, then claim each reward from your Twitch inventory within 24 hours. In game, collect the items from the Quicksilver Synthesis Companion on the Space Anomaly.

codesFaq.question: Where do I collect free rewards in game?
codesFaq.answer: Twitch Drop items are picked up from the Quicksilver Synthesis Companion aboard the Space Anomaly, and expedition rewards are claimed at the expedition terminal on the same station.

codesFaq.question: Can I still get older expedition rewards?
codesFaq.answer: Yes. Every past expedition can be replayed from the Space Anomaly terminal, and Hello Games regularly re-runs limited-time expeditions, so their exclusive ships, multitools, and cosmetics can still be earned.

faq.description: Quick answers about the game and this site.

items.question: What is the Cosmos update?
items.answer: Cosmos is the No Man's Sky 10th anniversary update, announced on August 9, 2026. It adds free interstellar flight — flying between star systems without warping — and the ability to land on stars using new heat-resistant gear.

items.question: Can you land on stars in No Man's Sky?
items.answer: Yes — landing on stars is the headline feature of the Cosmos update. You need new heat-resistant equipment to survive the approach. Our landing on stars guide covers what is confirmed so far.

items.question: Is No Man's Sky free to play?
items.answer: No. No Man's Sky is a premium game on PC (Steam, GOG, Epic), PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and Mac. All major updates, including Cosmos, are free for existing owners.

items.question: How long do expeditions run?
items.answer: Most expeditions run for about six weeks. Past expeditions return as Redux re-runs, usually around holiday seasons, so rare rewards are never permanently missable.
